seoCopy: Magenta Midnight Bloom brings together a rich magenta base, fine gold sprig embroidery, navy floral accents and puff sleeves. The listed work is Aari-style embroidery with floral motifs and beadwork; exact fibre and bead composition are not specified, so confirm materials during your enquiry. On the front, radiating gold-toned details frame a broad rounded neckline, with matching borders along the sleeves and hem. A magenta or wine saree creates a tonal look, while navy, midnight blue, cream or gold can pick up the contrasting motifs. Choose with the saree's zari, border and jewellery in view, and ask to discuss motif placement or colour adjustments before work begins. The listed starting price is ₹4,499 for embroidery on a customer-supplied blouse or garment. The garment, courier and any material changes beyond the displayed design are quoted separately. No fixed crafting timeline is stated; provide your event date and garment readiness so the studio can assess the brief and confirm a feasible schedule against current workload.
